intro.text: This Privacy Policy explains what personal information Chalkie Chalkie collects when you use our website and whiteboard at chalkiechalkie.com (the 'Services'), why we collect it, who we share it with, how long we keep it, and the rights you have over it.

Chalkie Chalkie is run by Harrison Baghurst, a sole trader based in the United Kingdom, trading as Chalkie Chalkie ('we', 'us', or 'our'). We are the controller of your personal information for the purposes of UK data protection law. You can contact us about anything in this policy at {{CONTACT_EMAIL}}.

**In short:** we collect what we need to run your account and your lessons, and nothing else. We do not sell your information, show adverts, use analytics or tracking cookies, or build profiles of you. Many of our users are students, some of them under 18, and we have designed the Services with that in mind.

blocks.text: Information you give us

items.description: Your name, email address and, if you add one to your account, a profile photo. Your profile photo is stored by Clerk and is not shown to other users. Sign-in is handled by Clerk, which stores your password in a protected form or sends you sign-in codes by email.
Which tutors and students are linked to each other, and the link codes used to connect you.
The lessons you host or are invited to: their schedule, who is in them, and any feedback a tutor writes about a lesson.
Everything drawn, written or placed on a workspace's board, including images and PDFs uploaded to it.
If you contact us or send a bug report, your email address and whatever you include in your message, such as your browser and operating system.

If you report a concern, what you tell us, what it is about, the workspace and person it concerns if you choose them, and your account or, if you are signed out, your email address. If someone reports a concern about you, we hold that report too.

blocks.text: Information created when you use the Services

items.description: While you are in a workspace, the position of your cursor and what you have selected are shared live with the other people in it. This is not stored after the lesson.
For tutors: your plan, its status, your billing dates, and how many workspaces you have created in the current billing period.
Your IP address, used briefly to limit the number of requests any one connection can make, and records of errors, which may include your account ID.

blocks.text: Information from Stripe

If you buy a plan, the payment is taken by Stripe through its Link service (see section 4). Stripe tells us your customer and subscription reference numbers, your plan, whether your payments have gone through, and your billing dates. **We never receive or store your card details.**
What we do not collect

We do not ask for your date of birth, gender, address or phone number, and we do not collect special category information such as health or ethnicity. We do not use analytics, advertising or tracking technologies. Our [Cookie Policy](/cookie-policy) lists the only cookies we use.

sections.heading: 2. How we use your information and our legal reasons

blocks.text: UK data protection law requires a lawful basis for each way we use your information. These are ours:

items.term: To create and run your account and provide the Services
items.description: Including signing you in, linking tutors and students, running workspaces and the live whiteboard, and enforcing plan limits. **Basis:** performance of our contract with you. For students under 18, our legitimate interest in providing the lessons their tutor and family have arranged.

items.term: To take payment and manage plans
items.description: Including knowing which plan you are on, when it renews and whether a payment has failed. **Basis:** performance of our contract with you.

items.term: To keep the Services and their users safe
items.description: Including limiting request rates, preventing misuse, investigating reports of harmful content or behaviour, and acting on them. **Basis:** our legitimate interest in protecting our users, especially children, and our legal obligations under online safety law.
Including recording and investigating errors. **Basis:** our legitimate interest in keeping the Services working.
When you contact us or report a bug. **Basis:** our legitimate interest in answering you.

items.term: To tell you about important changes
items.description: Such as changes to these policies, our terms or your plan's price. **Basis:** performance of our contract with you and our legal obligations.

items.term: To keep records and meet the law
items.description: Including responding to lawful requests from the authorities. **Basis:** legal obligation.

blocks.text: We do not send marketing emails. If we ever want to, we will ask for your consent first. We do not make decisions about you by purely automated means that have legal or similarly significant effects.

items: **People in the same workspace** can see your name, an avatar showing your initials, your live cursor and selections, and everything on the board. They cannot see your email address unless you are also directly linked to them.
**Tutors and students who are directly linked** can see each other's name and email address.
**A student's tutor** can see the lessons that student has been invited to and any feedback the tutor has written about them.

blocks.text: Nothing on Chalkie Chalkie is public. There are no public profiles, and a workspace can only be seen by the people its tutor has invited.

sections.heading: 4. Who we share your information with

blocks.text: We do not sell your information or share it with advertisers. We use the following service providers, who process it on our behalf under contracts that only let them use it to provide their service to us:

items.description: Account sign-up, sign-in and account security.
Our main database, holding accounts, links, workspaces, plans and usage.
The live whiteboard, where board content is stored, and storage for uploaded images and PDFs.
Short-lived request counters used for rate limiting.
Hosting for our website and servers.
Delivering messages sent through our contact form to us.

blocks.text: Stripe and Link

Payments are handled by Stripe Managed Payments. Stripe, through its Link service, is the merchant of record for your purchase. It collects your payment details, name and billing address directly from you at checkout, and uses them as a separate controller under its own privacy policy, available at [stripe.com/privacy](https://stripe.com/privacy).
Other situations

We may share information if the law requires it, if we need to in order to protect someone from harm (for example, reporting a safeguarding concern to the police), or to establish or defend legal claims. If the business is ever transferred to someone else, your information would pass to them under this policy, and we would tell you first.

Our database and rate-limiting providers store your information in the UK and European Union. Cloudflare runs the live whiteboard on its global network, and Clerk, Vercel, Resend and Stripe are based in the United States, so your information may be processed outside the UK.

Where your information is transferred outside the UK, we make sure it is protected by UK adequacy regulations (including the UK Extension to the EU–US Data Privacy Framework) or by the International Data Transfer Agreement or Addendum approved by the Information Commissioner's Office. You can ask us for more detail.

sections.heading: 6. How long we keep your information

items.description: Until you delete it. Deleting your account removes your account details, links, plan records and the workspaces you host straight away.
Deleted automatically after the period the host's plan allows after the lesson (14, 30 or 90 days), and at most 30 days after the host's plan ends.
Deleted 7 days after they are created.
Not stored. They exist only while you are in a workspace.
Expire automatically, within an hour at most.
Kept for as long as needed to investigate and fix the problem.
Kept for as long as needed to deal with your message.
Kept for as long as needed to act on them and to keep a record of how we handled them. They are not deleted when an account they mention is deleted, because they may be needed to protect someone.
Kept by Stripe as merchant of record, for as long as it is required to by law.

blocks.text: Deleted information may remain in our providers' encrypted backups for a short time before it is overwritten.

sections.heading: 7. How we keep your information safe

blocks.text: We use technical and organisational measures appropriate to the risk, including encrypted connections, access controls that limit each workspace to the people invited to it, short-lived access tickets for the live whiteboard, and rate limiting. No system is completely secure, so if we become aware of a breach that puts your information at risk, we will tell you and the Information Commissioner's Office where the law requires.

You must be 13 or over to have a Chalkie Chalkie account. Students under 18 need the agreement of a parent or guardian, and a parent or guardian can create and manage an account on their child's behalf. Only adults can buy a plan. If we learn that an account belongs to someone under 13, we will close it and delete its information.
We follow the Information Commissioner's Office's Age Appropriate Design Code for all users. That means:

items: we collect only what is needed to run lessons;
we do not show adverts, use tracking or analytics, or build profiles of anyone;
workspaces are private to the people their tutor invites, and nothing is public;
we do not share children's information except as this policy describes;
anyone, with or without an account, can use Report a concern or email us at {{CONTACT_EMAIL}} (see our [Terms of Service](/terms-of-service)).

blocks.text: A short version for students

We keep your name, email and what you draw in lessons so your tutor can teach you. Only the people in your lesson can see your board. Your lessons are deleted automatically after a while. We never sell your information or use it for adverts. You can ask us to show you or delete what we hold about you, or ask a parent or guardian to help. If anything on Chalkie Chalkie worries you, tell a trusted adult or press Report a concern. Only we see your report, not the person it is about.
Under UK data protection law you have the right to:

items: ask for a copy of the personal information we hold about you;
ask us to correct information that is wrong or incomplete;
ask us to delete your information;
ask us to restrict how we use your information;
object to us using your information where we rely on legitimate interests;
ask for information you gave us in a format that can be moved to another service.

blocks.text: You can update your name, email and profile photo from your account menu, and delete your account at any time from Settings. For anything else, email us at {{CONTACT_EMAIL}}. We will respond within one month. A parent or guardian can make a request on behalf of a child where that is in the child's best interests.
If you are unhappy with how we have handled your personal information, please contact us first at {{CONTACT_EMAIL}}.

items: We will acknowledge your complaint within 30 days of receiving it.
We will investigate without unjustifiable or excessive delay.
We will keep you informed of progress and explain the outcome.

blocks.text: If you are not happy with our response, you can complain to the Information Commissioner's Office, the UK data protection regulator, at [ico.org.uk/make-a-complaint](https://ico.org.uk/make-a-complaint) or on 0303 123 1113.

We will update this policy when the way we handle personal information changes. The date at the top shows when it was last changed. If a change is significant, we will tell you by email or through the Services before it takes effect.
Chalkie Chalkie is run by Harrison Baghurst, a sole trader, trading as Chalkie Chalkie. You can contact us about this policy or your personal information at {{CONTACT_EMAIL}}.
